title: 第1章 十世轮回你想找死第2章 丑恶嘴脸逐出林家
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“这位兄弟，我是天元镇旁支林家家主林毅，特地前来求见大长老，还请帮忙通传。”
弘丰城，林家府邸外。
林毅走上前去，说话间就递给守卫十多块灵石。
“你们且稍等片刻，容我去通传大长老，只不过大长老日理万机，见不见你，我就不知道了。”
守卫见到林毅这么识趣，顺势将灵石收下后，转身朝着身后的府邸走去。
“义父，不能开脉就算了，我们回天元镇吧。”
林晨看着林毅低声下气的模样，忍不住叹息。
他轮回九世，百万年间九次成为顶尖强者，踏入这片天地至强者行列，却始终无法突破天地桎梏，踏入天帝之上的境界。
于是他将九世积累，全部散入天地间，开始了第十世轮回。
待他再次醒来，如今是十万年过去了。
整个九天十地在这万年间，可谓是热闹非凡，各种跨时代的天骄层出不穷。
他散在天地间的意念和传承，让瑶池圣地多了一尊女大帝，也让太一上宗多了一个无敌小师叔，还有一个肉身无敌的不死大帝，以及镇守魔界三万年的狠人大帝……
“晨儿，你放心，大长老早年曾受过你祖父的恩惠，肯定会出手助你打开灵脉。”
这些年以来，尽管无法开脉，林晨却依旧坚持不懈，夜以继日的打磨肉身，没有丝毫懈怠，他都看在眼中。
林晨再过半个月，就超过十六岁。
如果超过十六岁无法开脉，就意味着一辈子无法修炼，只能做普通人。
他实在不忍心看着这么一颗好苗子，毁于一旦。
见到林毅继续坚持，林晨也不再多言，十多年的相处下来，林毅的性格他也很了解，想要说动对方，也不是易事。
索性就随他去吧。
至于林家大长老，愿不愿意消耗灵力助他开脉，都不重要，他这些年一直在等太虚造化树凝聚十万年的第一枚造化道果成熟，就可以开始开脉。

执拗不过林毅，就当走个过场。
“跟我来吧！”
小会儿时间，守卫就来到林毅和林晨身前，领着二人朝着林家府邸里面走去。
错落有致的院落，亭台楼阁矗立其间，青石板铺就而成的道路，整个府邸显得宽阔庞大。
三人很快就来到一座庞大院落外面，那里还站着两个中年男子，他们身上的气息，都不弱于林毅。
“大长老在里面等你，你们进去吧。”
守卫男子对着林毅和林晨说了一声，转身朝着府邸外离去。
“晨儿，你开脉有望了。”
林毅脸上忍不住流露出笑意。
率先就迈开脚步，带着林晨朝着院子里面走去。
就见到院落中间，一个头发花白的老者，身穿淡灰色长袍，整个人气息深沉，目光如炬。
他就是弘丰城林家大长老林华，修为已经达到通神境巅峰，只差一步就可以凝聚气海，就算是在整个弘丰城，都是排名前列的强者。
他身前站着一个十八九岁的青年，他是林华的亲孙子林庆，已经踏入融血境。
见到林毅和林晨时，神色间流露出鄙夷，眼高于顶，根本看不起林毅他们这些旁支家族的人。
content_en:
"Brother, I am Lin Yi, the head of the Lin family, a branch of Tianyuan Town. I have come here specifically to ask for an audience with the great elder. Please help me pass the message."
Hongfeng City, outside the Lin family's mansion.
Ji Yi stepped forward and handed the guard more than ten spiritual stones as he spoke.
"Please wait a moment and let me inform the Great Elder. It's just that the Great Elder is busy with many things, so I don't know whether he can see you or not."
Seeing that Lin Yi was so sensible, the guard took the spirit stone and turned around and walked towards the mansion behind him.
"Father, forget it if you can't open your pulse. Let's go back to Tianyuan Town."
Lin Chen couldn't help but sigh when he saw Lin Yi's humble appearance.
He reincarnated for nine lives and became a top expert nine times in a million years. He stepped into the ranks of the strongest in this world, but he was still unable to break through the shackles of heaven and earth and step into the realm above the Emperor of Heaven.
So he accumulated nine lives and dispersed them all into the world, starting the tenth reincarnation.
When he woke up again, one hundred thousand years had passed.
During these ten thousand years, the entire Nine Heavens and Ten Earths was extremely lively, with all kinds of geniuses across the ages emerging one after another.
His thoughts and inheritance scattered in the world have given Yaochi Holy Land a female emperor, Taiyi Shangzong has an invincible junior uncle, a physically invincible immortal emperor, and a ruthless emperor who has guarded the demon world for 30,000 years...
"Chen'er, don't worry. The Great Elder received favor from your grandfather in the early years and will definitely help you open your spiritual veins."
Over the years, even though he could not open his pulse, Lin Chen still persevered, polishing his body day and night without any slack, and he saw it all.
Lin Chen will be over sixteen in another half month.
If you are over 16 years old and cannot open your pulse, it means that you will not be able to practice for the rest of your life and will only be an ordinary person.
He really couldn't bear to see such a good seedling ruined in one day.
Seeing that Lin Yi continued to persist, Lin Chen stopped talking. After more than ten years of getting along with him, he also understood Lin Yi's character very well. It was not easy to persuade the other party.
Just let him be.
As for the great elder of the Lin family, it doesn't matter whether he is willing to expend spiritual power to help him open his pulse. He has been waiting for the first creation Dao Fruit condensed by the Taixu Creation Tree for 100,000 years to mature over the years, and then he can start to open his pulse.
If you can't stand up to Ji Yi, it's just a formality.
"Come with me!"
After a short time, the guards came to Lin Yi and Lin Chen and led them towards the Lin family's mansion.
The well-proportioned courtyards, pavilions and pavilions stand among them, and the roads paved with bluestone slabs make the entire mansion look spacious and huge.
The three of them soon came to the outside of a huge courtyard, where two middle-aged men were standing. The auras on their bodies were no weaker than Lin Yi's.
"The Great Elder is waiting for you inside. You go in."
The guarding man said something to Ji Yi and Lin Chen, turned around and left outside the mansion.
"Chen'er, if you take a pulse, it will be possible."
Ji Yi couldn't help but smile on his face.
He took the lead and took Lin Chen towards the courtyard.
In the middle of the courtyard, he saw an old man with gray hair, wearing a light gray robe, with a deep aura and bright eyes.
He is Lin Hua, the eldest elder of the Lin family in Hongfeng City. His cultivation has reached the peak of the divine realm. He is only one step away from being able to condense the sea of ​​qi. Even in the entire Hongfeng City, he is ranked among the strongest.
Standing in front of him was a young man of eighteen or nineteen years old. He was Lin Qing, Lin Hua's grandson, who had entered the blood-melting realm.
When they saw Ji Yi and Lin Chen, their expressions showed contempt, their eyes were higher than their heads, and they looked down on Lin Yi and other members of the branch family at all.
